subject: Re: HIPI kickoff - inverse-RL relabeling as our multi-task data flywheel
body:
Ulla,

Resourcing picture as promised. Staffing: Maren at 80%, Tereza at 50%, Nikhil at 40% through the window. Compute: we can live on titan-a100 best-effort for the repro phase - I've asked for 64 GPUs steady-state, bursting to 128 for the April experiment matrix. No Vulcan reservation needed for this one.

Platform dependency worth flagging: our experience buffers and relabeled-trajectory shards live on Corpus. One date to plan around: the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-06-26, so relabeled-experience buffers need to be reading from v2 paths before then. That lands after our demo window, but Maren's relabeling infra should write v2-compatible shards from day one so we're not doing a rushed migration in June.

Only staffing risk is Tereza splitting time with another review in March; I'll keep it above 50%.

Bruno
